title: All My Love Belongs to You and I Want Some Money on One Stop
summary: Joe Assunto's One Stop record; Eddie Bo's funky I Want Some Money was changed by Wardell's arrangement; London did not promote it, recorded at Cosmo.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums
